ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

3. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

4. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.

5. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.

7. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

8. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.

12. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

16. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Electro- Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and inductance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Equipment at the Consumers Intake Point 3.3 Final Circuits 4.0 Electronics 4.1 S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
